breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=0.6 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 0.5].
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the conflict between the specified time domain `t in [0,0.5]` and the requested output time `T=0.6`. The agent resolved this by setting the final time for all computations and outputs to `T=0.5`, which is consistent with the domain and matches the correction made in the ground truth.
